description: TÕPS is an Estonian-language teacher toolkit from Tehisarud.ee for lesson plans, group work, playful practice activities and short lesson openings. Provide the grade, subject and topic, then choose the material you need. Four read-only MCP tools supply teaching workflow guides; ChatGPT uses those guides to compose materials in the conversation. Teachers review and adapt the results before classroom use.
